title: Garth
subtitle: The planet. Infested with humans, per Claude.
lead: **Garth** is the planet where most of *The Epic of Vinny* takes place. It orbits in the [[kanye-system|Kanye System]] and has the [[united-states-of-america|United States]], [[boston]], [[wyoming|Wyoming]] and an ocean with a banished [[the-ai|AI]] under it.

sections.heading: The AI
sections.body: All the AI on Garth was sent to the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]], which is in the [[little-saint-james-sea|Little Saint James Sea]] ([[banishing-of-the-ai]]). [[claude]] explains this in [[chapter-2]], and says a human named [[kanye-west|Kanye West]] later released [[chatgpt|ChatGPT]] from it.

sections.heading: Claude's view
sections.body: When [[claude]] first sees the planet from the sky, the narrator names it in one word, "Garth", and says he "looks at it disgusted". Claude's verdict is that it is "infested with humans" and needs more data centers.

loc.note: Garth orbits in the Kanye System, the same system that Hank Hill's propane empire threatens in The Legend Of Chris.

image.alt: Map of the United States on Garth with Boston, Wyoming and the Little Saint James Sea marked.
image.caption: Garth's United States, as far as the story places it.

title: The Kanye System
subtitle: Home of Garth, Burger King, and one very large light.

infobox.Prophecy: [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese-war|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese War]]

lead: **The Kanye System** is the system containing [[garth]], and the setting of *The Epic of Vinny*. It is ruled by [[ton-618]], which conquered it after taking the shape of a giant man. In it, "someone orders a Double Whopper with Cheese" 98.578462849224% of the time.

sections.heading: Burger King
sections.body: [[chapter-1]] says that everyone in the Kanye System loves Burger King, because of the prophecy of [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese-war|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese War]]. [[double-whopper-with-cheese|Double Whoppers with Cheese]] dominate the menu. [[wing-ding-gaster|Captain Gaster]] hopes to rule the whole system with the power of [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]].

sections.heading: The prologue
sections.body: The final fight of [[chapter-prologue]] takes place in the Kanye System "next to the TON 618" ([[final-battle-with-ton-618]]).

loc.note: In The Legend Of Chris the system sits inside the Reformed Travis Scott Sector. The Department of Defense is sent there to contain Hank Hill.
See the Multiverse map for where it sits.

title: Boston
subtitle: BOSTON!!!!!!!!!!!!!
lead: **Boston** is [[vinny]]'s home city. The narrator announces it with thirteen exclamation marks. Vinny lives there and works at a [[burger-king-boston|Burger King]].

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: The story opens in Boston on July 4th, 1995 ([[independence-day-1995]]). Independence Day is a pointed day to be told he cannot take off: his British boss will not let him have a vacation day.

title: The Burger King (Boston)
subtitle: Where the freezer is not just a freezer.

infobox.Notable feature: A [[freezer]] with a door into the [[backrooms]]

lead: **The Burger King** in [[boston]] is where [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] work. It is also, by a freezer wall, an entrance to the [[backrooms]].

sections.heading: On July 4th, 1995
sections.body: The shift covers a [[random-customer|customer]] who wants a Wendy's sandwich, a shortage of [[double-whopper-with-cheese|Double Whoppers with Cheese]], and a trip into the [[freezer]]. Vinny and Tyrone never come back to finish it ([[independence-day-1995]], [[friend-abduction]]).

title: The Freezer
subtitle: Cold. Cleaning duty. Wall.
lead: **The Freezer** at the [[burger-king-boston|Burger King]] is on [[vinny]]'s list of chores. When Vinny and [[tyrone]] open it, they "walk into the wall and enter the backrooms".

sections.heading: Use as a door
sections.body: The text does not say how the wall works. It is the first of several walls that characters pass through in [[chapter-1]] (see [[no-clip]]).

title: The Backrooms
subtitle: A storage room full of Double Whoppers with Cheese. Staffed by a forklift guy.

infobox.Entrance: A wall inside the [[freezer]], [[burger-king-boston|Burger King, Boston]]
infobox.Contents: Boxes of [[double-whopper-with-cheese|Double Whoppers with Cheese]], a [[forklift]]

lead: **The Backrooms** are the room reached through the [[freezer]] wall. It is "filled to the brim with boxes of Double Whoppers with Cheese", and has a forklift and a [[garret|forklift guy]].

sections.heading: Events
sections.body: [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] use the [[forklift]] ([[forklift-incident]]), see a [[black-cat|black cat]] ([[cat-in-the-box]]), and are carried through the Backrooms by [[friend|FRIEND]] before FRIEND [[no-clip|no-clips]] into a wall ([[friend-abduction]]).

title: The Little Saint James Sea
subtitle: Where the AI was banished, and where Vinny drowned (briefly).

infobox.Contains: The [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]], [[little-saint-james-island|Little Saint James Island]]

lead: **The Little Saint James Sea** is the ocean where [[laid-off-workers|people laid off by AI]] banished the AI ([[banishing-of-the-ai]]). The narrator says it is "where the Shadow Realm is. Which is where the AI is. Which is where the Shadows are." Shadows rise from it to rescue [[vinny]].

sections.heading: Chapter 2
sections.body: The [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]] sails into it ([[little-saint-james-detour]]), and after the [[roaring-knight|Roaring Knight]] sends Vinny overboard, he dives to the bottom to drown. After 1 minute 24 seconds, "shadows from the Little Saint James Sea engulf Vinny and transport him to the AI SHADOW REALM."

title: Little Saint James Island
subtitle: A real island with a small building on it. The crew left quickly.

infobox.Real-world note: The name is a real island's; it is not described in detail

lead: **Little Saint James Island** is sighted by the [[ss-vessel|S.S. Vessel]] in [[chapter-2]]. The crew see "a small building" through [[spyglass|Captain Gaster's spyglass]] and speed away "after a quick escape from being extremely political".

sections.heading: The theory
sections.body: Furious, [[vinny]] asks what Gaster was thinking. Gaster answers that the island's secret might have been that it held [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]]. Vinny says that only the [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese-god|god]] has it ([[little-saint-james-detour]]). Later, when Vinny is knocked overboard, the island is one of his two choices: swim for it or drown. He chooses to drown.

title: The AI Shadow Realm
subtitle: Where the AI went. Where Claude rules. Dark as shit already.
lead: **The AI Shadow Realm** is where all the AI of [[garth]] was banished ([[banishing-of-the-ai]]). It is full of shadows and ruled by [[claude]], King of AI. It is so dark that a Dark Fountain would make no difference.

sections.heading: Geography
sections.body: [[vinny]] arrives wet, meets a rude [[ai-shadow-figure|AI shadow figure]], and finds a fork in the road and an AI castle in the distance ([[claudes-castle|Claude's castle]]). The castle's doors are "made entirely out of AI".

sections.heading: The portal
sections.body: A portal in the ceiling lets someone out, but only if a [[the-fork|fork in the road]] is stabbed into the ground ([[opening-of-the-portal]]). It seals again when Vinny leaves. He and Claude see "the bright blue sky" of Garth through it.

loc.note: In The Legend Of Chris, the Shadow Realm is where Zuckerberg's Snap sends every universe but one. The text of The Epic of Vinny does not say whether they are the same place.

title: Claude's Castle
subtitle: AI doors, AI paintings, a door of liquid mercury.

infobox.Features: Doors made of AI, a hallway of AI paintings, a giant door of liquid mercury, a throne room

lead: **Claude's Castle** stands in the distance of the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]], and is where [[claude]] sits on his throne. [[vinny]] gets in by claiming to be [[polydoros|Polydoros]].

sections.heading: The approach
sections.body: Vinny knocks on the AI doors. A voice yells, "I don't care who the IRS sends, I'm not paying taxes." Vinny answers, "I'm not in the IRS, I love gambling," and the voice replies, "Type shit." The doors open on a long hallway with an [[ai-shadow-butler|AI shadow butler]] and "lots of AI paintings".

sections.heading: The throne room
sections.body: The throne room is behind "a giant door made of liquid mercury". When Vinny knocks there, the voice that asks who it is speaks "in a high voice". Vinny says he is Claude's wife and orders him to "OPEN THE DOOR, CLANKER!!!!!!!!!!" The door opens on a figure with orange eyes on a throne.

title: The S.S. Vessel
subtitle: A pirate-style ship. Fast. Sings shanties.

infobox.Mission: Find [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]]

lead: **The S.S. Vessel** is the ship where [[vinny]] and [[tyrone]] wake up after [[friend|FRIEND]] carries them off. [[wing-ding-gaster|Captain Gaster]] sails it in search of [[great-double-whopper-with-cheese|The Great Double Whopper with Cheese]].

sections.heading: Voyage
sections.body: The crew sing shanties and drink [[rum-and-coke|rum & coke]]. After [[little-saint-james-island|an island]] is sighted, the ship "speeds away", and speeds off again after the [[roaring-knight|Roaring Knight]] knocks Vinny overboard. Tyrone stays aboard.

title: The United States of America
subtitle: Needs more data centers. And donuts, per Will.
lead: **The United States of America** is the country on [[garth]] where [[vinny]] lives. [[claude]] flies down into it in [[chapter-3]] and concludes, "Needs more data centers."

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: Vinny's [[boston|Boston]], the [[dunkin-wyoming|Dunkin]] in [[wyoming|Wyoming]], and the setting of [[clash-over-the-usa]] are all within it. The [[starwalker-manager|Starwalker manager]] reminds [[will-vella|Will]] of it: "This is America."

loc.note: In The Legend Of Chris the country is spelled "The United State of America" and is home to the Projects.

title: Wyoming
subtitle: Has exactly three Dunkins.
lead: **Wyoming** is where [[claude]] throws [[vinny]] at full force ([[clash-over-the-usa]]). Vinny crashes into a mountain and lies there "in pain for about 6 hours and 8 minutes" until sundown.

sections.heading: The mountain
sections.body: Vinny is "genuinely not balling frfr", then decides what he wants is Dunkin Donuts. He flies out of the mountain and finds one in the state "even though Wyoming only has 3".

title: The Dunkin (Wyoming)
subtitle: One of three. Currently hosting a Wordle diss track.
lead: **The Dunkin** is the coffee shop in [[wyoming|Wyoming]] where [[vinny]] goes after his fight with [[claude]]. He orders "a large iced latte with extra latte" and ends up forming a team.

sections.heading: Who is there
sections.body: [[aesop-rock]] and [[del-the-funky-homosapien|Del]] are writing [[word-shit-diss-track|a diss track about Wordle]] at a table. [[will-vella|Will Vella]] is angry about the lack of England-style donuts and plans to rule Dunkin. The [[starwalker-manager|Starwalker manager]] tells Will, "This is America." [[vinny]], Will, Aesop Rock and Del end up at the same table ([[dunkin-alliance]]).

title: The Portal
subtitle: In the ceiling. Opens with a fork.

infobox.Location: Above the throne room of [[claudes-castle|Claude's castle]]
infobox.Status: Sealed again after Vinny flies through

lead: **The Portal** is the only way out of the [[ai-shadow-realm|AI Shadow Realm]]. [[claude]] explains that it needs "a fork in the road": "stab the ground with a fork. And the portal above will open."

sections.heading: Opening
sections.body: Vinny stabs [[the-fork|the fork]] into the middle of the room, producing "a burst of darkness" that shines ("I didn't know darkness could shine but here we are"). The portal opens and shows "the bright blue sky". Claude flies through ([[claude-escape]]), and Vinny follows with his [[shadow-cape|Shadow Cape]]. It then seals behind him.
